name: band down to up twist
description: A diagonal twisting movement with a band from low to high. It trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Anchor the band low and stand sideways to it, holding the end with both hands.
Start with your hands near the low hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body as you rotate your torso.
Pivot your back foot and keep your arms long.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.
